export_duties_source: Secretaría de Agricultura, Ganadería y Pesca (MAGyP) / ARCA (Derechos de Exportación - Retenciones)
gross_receipts_source: ARBA / Rentas provinciales (Ingresos Brutos agropecuarios producción primaria ~1%)
transaction_tax_source: Ley 25.413, impuesto sobre los creditos y debitos bancarios: 0.6% on each debit and 0.6% on each credit. The engine charges it once per cash movement, so the rate per movement is 0.6%.
land_tax_source: ARBA / Inmobiliario Rural provincial de Buenos Aires (estimado ~$15 USD/ha/año)
income_tax_source: Ley de Impuesto a las Ganancias (tasa corporativa general 35%; company rate — individual producers face progressive personal rates)
export_fx_source: Banco Central de la República Argentina (BCRA Comunicación A 3500)
disclaimer: Orientative guide based on public rates as of 2026; not tax advice; consult an accountant.
_review: Export duty rates were lowered during 2025 and must be checked against the decree in force; the land tax is an estimate. Provisional.
